description: This source file implements the creation, initialization, object enrollment, and removal functions for the Bmc2 Com Executor object in a BroadWay Management Console system. It defines functions such as Bmc2ComeoCreate, Bmc2ComeoRemove, Bmc2ComeoEnrollObjects, and Bmc2ComeoInitialize, which manage the lifecycle and configuration of the executor object, including setting up internal interfaces and related components.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE Bmc2ComeoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new Bmc2ComExecutor object, setting up its base object properties and function pointers.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS Bmc2ComeoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the specified Bmc2ComExecutor object, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS Bmc2ComeoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls necessary sub-objects and interfaces for the Bmc2ComExecutor, including creating the SOA interface.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS Bmc2ComeoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes member variables and function pointers of the Bmc2ComExecutor object, including setting up its methods and identifiers.
